usage_description: PECmd is used for parsing Windows Prefetch files, which can provide evidence of program execution and help establish patterns of activity.

suspicious_indicators.description: A high run count for an executable may indicate frequent or suspicious usage.
Unknown or suspiciously named executables can be a sign of malicious activity.

known_false_positives: High run counts for common system utilities may not always indicate malicious activity.
Prefetch files from legitimate software updates might have unexpected high run counts.
